name: smwmusic-piyopiyoplayer-end-of-sorrow
title: PiyoPiyoPlayer - End of Sorrow
description:
A dark, creepy, and glitch-ish song, made by Pixel on his spare time, in a collection of songs from PiyoPiyoPlayer.

It does uses the KDL3 soundfont.

Original description by Pixel
Original:
○悲しみの果て：RPG系の曲かな･･･。暗い。
Rough translation:
• The end of sadness: I think it's an RPG song ... dark.
